items.text: Ravens listed QB Lamar Jackson full participant second straight day (ankle); Rapoport: poised to return vs Bills.
items.why: Consecutive full practices after missing three games; insider confirmation of return expectation.
items.implication: Unlocks Ravens offense; boost to pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Full snap share expected; elevated targets for Flowers/Henry/Andrews.

items.text: Patriots WR AJ Brown DNP Thursday (knee flare-up added to ankle); status for Sunday vs MIA up in the air. Schefter confirms non-participant after limited Wednesday.
items.why: Knee issue flared; not spotted at practice; dual ankle/knee.
items.implication: Game-time or risk of sit; monitor Friday designation closely.
items.opportunity: If OUT, targets to other NE WRs; if IN, still volume but efficiency concerns.

items.text: Thorman (ETR): didn't love the look of that for Christian Watson's collarbone (knocks wood) during/after Packers game action.
items.why: In-game visual concern from ETR's Thorman.
items.implication: Potential injury risk; check status/next practice.
items.opportunity: If limited/OUT, boost to other GB WRs like Wicks/Reed.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle on Berry HATE list: production hasn't been there; Chiefs allowed just one TD to opposing WR all season (to JSN).
items.why: Soft recent production + elite Chiefs WR defense + chest injury cloud.
items.implication: Sit/fade in most formats despite name value.
items.opportunity: Low TD upside vs tough matchup.
items.conflict: Injury status may further limit if active but compromised.

items.text: One day after DNP (ankle/rest), Bengals listed WR Ja'Marr Chase as full participant Thursday.
items.why: Schefter report of practice participation upgrade after Wednesday rest/ankle DNP.
items.implication: Expected to play; maintain WR1 status vs TEN.

items.text: Zay Flowers is Berry's WR5 this week; LOVE with Lamar Jackson expected back unlocking the offense.
items.why: Lamar return; historical high target rate (48% routes) with Jackson; track-meet game script vs BUF.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle (chest) DNP Wednesday, limited Thursday after aggravation; status TBD vs KC but returned to practice.
items.why: Chest injury from prior game dive; limited return Thursday.
items.implication: Uncertain for Sunday; production already soft.
items.opportunity: If limited/OUT, elevated role for other DEN WRs.

items.text: Colston Loveland averaging 30% target share and 19.2 PPG in two games since Caleb Williams return; leads TEs in utilization, top-5 finishes both weeks.
items.why: Berry 10 Facts: elevated target/utilization post-Williams return.

items.text: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) and WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) DNP Wednesday but both full participants Thursday; upgraded and expected to play.
items.why: Wednesday DNPs (Gibbs unexpected shoulder, St. Brown planned ankle); Thursday full return per reports.
items.implication: Both lock starters vs MIN; no major role loss.

items.text: Seahawks designated RB Jadarian Price for return to practice.
items.implication: Potential depth/handcuff activation soon; monitor for role.
items.opportunity: Could impact SEA RB snaps if elevated.

items.text: Berry LOVES Derrick Henry (RB6) @ BUF and Chase Brown (RB8) vs TEN for Week 8 workloads/matchups.
items.why: Henry with Lamar unlock and game script; Brown volume vs weak TEN run D.
items.opportunity: Carries + potential receiving work; red-zone for Henry.

items.text: Berry HATES Saquon Barkley (RB20) @ WSH and Omarion Hampton (RB34) @ LAR this week.
items.why: Tough matchups and/or role/script concerns per Love/Hate.
items.implication: Fade or sit if better options; lower floor.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love returns to practice (per injury report context).
items.implication: Progress toward availability; monitor role vs Conner/etc.

items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba ripping 9 more actual fantasy points than opportunity implies despite losing OC Kubiak, few dynamic threats, DCs shading coverage, and stadium knowing the ball is going his way.
items.why: Data-driven efficiency vs depressed opportunity post-OC change and heavy coverage.
items.implication: Sustainable WR1 upside; continue starting confidently.
items.opportunity: High target share + efficiency even in tough environment.
